item.title: Streamline Your API Testing with Microcks GitLab Components
item.description: In today’s fast-paced development environment, API testing and contract validation are critical to shipping reliable software. But how do you efficiently integrate these practices into your GitLab CI/CD pipelines without complex configurations? That’s exactly what we’re solving with the Microcks GitLab Components!

item.title: Beyond Code: Open Source, Mentorship and Microcks
item.description: Open source software proves that collective contribution creates collective value. However, as a contributor to Microcks, I have observed a concerning pattern that threatens the sustainability of the project and countless others in the open source ecosystem.
